title: Minor : app version on UI no more in red if built with workflow
body:
@MilosKozak I built the last dev using "browser build". Even though my code is changed (automation % change only), the app version on the UI is not red as it was when built using AS.

Nothing really serious or important. Just FYI.

comments.body:
Not an issue
- it's  red within Android Studio when you build à working branch with uncommited changes.
- if you use Browser build, you build branch pushed within your repo, so you cannot have uncommited changes within your repo (uncommited updates in Android Studio remains in your computer and are not pushed in your repo.

So if you want to use browser build with personnal updates, you need to commit them, push your local branch in your repo, and then Browser Build will create your expected apks.
Yes, I understand. I was just signaling it for Milos' attention as he had set the red version number as a visual alert of a modified code. That alert is no more working.
it works like expected. it's red with uncommited changes
